title: PostgreSQL pg_restore executes arbitrary code due to missing non-plain archive validation (CVE-2026-116314)
description: A vulnerability in PostgreSQL's pg_restore utility allows arbitrary code execution due to improper input validation of non-plain archive formats. This flaw enables an attacker to execute code as the operating system user running pg_restore by supplying a crafted archive. The issue affects multiple PostgreSQL versions prior to their respective fixed releases.
